# UI text and icon loading

Fonts, licences, locale tables and icon sources remain because kept engine tests load them. No gallery, scenes, character art, audio, or gallery reference frames remain.

Readers: og-ui font/shaping tests, og-cook font/string tests, og-tests-cooked text/material frames, engine i18n and UI component tests.

Run through the named tests, not as a gameplay template. Asset-only fixtures
have no standalone playtest; their owning tests control the cook and assertions.
